newsitem.title: USA: Michael Anthony comfirms in merger talks.
newsitem.headline: Michael Anthony comfirms in merger talks.

text.p: Michael Anthony Jewelers Inc said Tuesday it is in preliminary merger discussions with OroAmerica Inc ). Earlier, in Burbank, Calif., OroAmerica Inc made its announcement on the talks
Michael Anthony said the companies discussed consideration of $7.50 in a combination of cash and Michael Anthony Jewelers stock for each OroAmerica share.
Michael Paolercio, chairman and chief executive, said discussions are in a preliminary stage and that the company is engaged in its due diligence review.
